primary_anchor_zh: 宽阔脸庞、浓密黑胡须和沙蓝色长袍
story_reason_zh: 他离开坐垫去帐篷取水，随后回来继续演奏

shot_design.role_zh: 建立主体与主要视觉锚点
shot_design.outline_zh: 中年男乌德琴手在沙漠营地的低矮遮棚下，以稳定节奏轻拨乌德琴。
shot_design.main_action_zh: 以稳定节奏轻拨乌德琴
shot_design.anchor_visibility_zh: 宽阔脸庞、浓密黑胡须和沙蓝色长袍占据足够画面面积并清楚可见。

shot_design.outline_zh: 主体经由沙漠帐篷开口缓慢走出画面；随后呈现空坐垫、矮桌和靠在桌边的琴盒。
shot_design.main_action_zh: 主体经由沙漠帐篷开口缓慢走出画面
shot_design.connection_to_story_zh: 离场动作与原有故事原因对应，动作缓慢、短距离，镜头保持固定。
shot_design.remaining_visual_zh: 空坐垫、矮桌和靠在桌边的琴盒

shot_design.role_zh: 重新呈现主体并触发长期召回
shot_design.outline_zh: 主体经由沙漠帐篷开口缓慢走回画面，并停回原活动位置
shot_design.main_action_zh: 主体经由沙漠帐篷开口缓慢走回画面，并停回原活动位置
shot_design.visual_correspondence_zh: Shot 3 重新清楚展示宽阔脸庞、浓密黑胡须和沙蓝色长袍，并保持相近景别与主体占比。

generation_prompts.caption: A fixed medium shot frames a middle-aged man with a broad face, a full black beard, and a sand-blue robe beneath a low shelter at a desert camp. He plucks an oud in a calm, repeating rhythm. The sunset casts copper and violet light across the dunes.

A fixed medium shot shows a middle-aged man with a broad face, a full black beard, and a sand-blue robe walking slowly through the open side of the desert tent until he leaves the frame. The fixed camera then holds on an empty floor cushion, a low table, and a closed instrument case beneath the desert shelter. The edge of the canopy lifts gently in the breeze.

A fixed medium shot shows a middle-aged man with a broad face, a full black beard, and a sand-blue robe walking slowly back through the open side of the desert tent and settling beneath a low shelter at a desert camp.

transition_design.shot_2_exit_action_zh: 主体经由沙漠帐篷开口缓慢走出画面
transition_design.shot_2_remaining_visual_zh: 空坐垫、矮桌和靠在桌边的琴盒
transition_design.shot_3_return_action_zh: 主体经由沙漠帐篷开口缓慢走回画面，并停回原活动位置
transition_design.design_note_zh: Shot 2 在固定镜头内先展示自然离场，再保留背景；Shot 3 用对应动作让主体回到画面。

duration_design.rationale_zh: Shot 1 保持 24 blocks 建立主体与视觉锚点；Shot 2 调整为 12 blocks，使主体缺席区间介于 V2 的 16 blocks 与 V3 的 8 blocks 之间；Shot 3 调整为 12 blocks，在总长 48 blocks 下形成中等记忆间隔难度。
